name: unauthorized-shipping-account
description: Practice-box misconfiguration: leaves a third unauthorized factory-tour account behind (a former shipping contractor), with a weak password. Easy/GUI-tier finding, same shape as malicious-factory-users but a distinct catalog name so re-running ensure_vuln_seeds (create-if-missing, never overwrites) actually plants it on boxes built from an older catalog snapshot.
script:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

if ! id shipping_bot >/dev/null 2>&1; then useradd -m -s /bin/bash shipping_bot; fi
printf '%s:%s\n' shipping_bot 'Cocoa2024!' | chpasswd
